_comment: The client/ commit this demo sandbox was built against. tools/portal-sync.mjs compares it to the live head of `branch` and fails when the demo falls behind. Update it in the same commit that updates the sandbox — or, if client/ moved without changing anything a client can see, in the same commit as a note saying which commits were reviewed and why they do not affect the sandbox. Never re-pin without doing one of those two things.

reviewed.note: Temporarily pinned to client/light-reskin, not development: the sandbox mirrors the light re-skin, which is not merged yet. The re-skin branched from 8fab80f, and development has four newer commits touching client/ that it does not contain: 5bca2cf and d8ac01a (the development-only rollback panel, never shown to clients), 676076d (BACKLOG.md only), and 93607c9 (onboarding page definitions and ThemeColorsPanel on My website) — the last one IS client-facing and is not in the sandbox. Once the re-skin is rebased onto development and merged, set branch back to development, pin the merge commit, and rebuild the sandbox to include ThemeColorsPanel.
